debate.key_bull_argument: Strong technical setup with Ichimoku cross, MACD crossover, three white soldiers, and price above major moving averages provides a textbook bullish entry signal with defined support at 55.45.
debate.key_bear_argument: Severe macro headwinds (inverted yield curve, VIX crisis levels), overbought oscillators with weak ADX trend strength, below-average volume conviction, zero fundamental catalysts, and upcoming earnings event risk in 49 days outweigh technical bullishness.
